feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Aboard an icebreaker, a writer got a closer look at the Arctic's 'Sea Change'
entry.summary: As polar ice melts in the Arctic, shipping lanes are opening up, making the region a new zone of superpower competition. Writer Rana Foroohar explains the stakes in Sea Change.

entry.title: 'New Yorker' cartoonists admit to having 'The Two Saddest Kitchens'
entry.summary: The Two Saddest Kitchens is a comic conversation between Roz Chast and Jason Adam Katzenstein. Book critic Maureen Corrigan says it made her laugh and feel better about her own (lack of) cooking.

entry.title: Inflation sizzled in September — and Social Security benefits will get a boost
entry.summary: Consumer prices in September jumped 3.7% from a year ago. The Social Security Administration said benefits will increase next year to help keep pace with the rising cost of living.

entry.title: Hands-on with the Ocarina of Time remake, the most ornate Zelda game ever made
entry.summary: We got to play The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time early. Here are our impressions of the remake and its elaborate new style.

entry.title: These workers help train robots who could one day steal their jobs
entry.summary: Factory workers in India are being asked to wear GoPro cameras to record the way they do their jobs. The ultimate goal is to train robots to take over. Will it work?

entry.title: Trump's ambassador to Greece, Kimberly Guilfoyle, resigns after allegations of improper conduct
entry.summary: The White House publicly asked for U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle's resignation on Tuesday as she faced mounting accusations of improper conduct.

entry.title: The skincare scheme that led to consumer complaints, lawsuits and a federal investigation
entry.summary: Free samples, high-pressure pitches and $50,000 bills: An NPR investigation reveals how a network of mall skincare stores systematically targeted older adults and people with disabilities across the U.S.

entry.title: VIDEO: The skincare sample is free. What happens next can cost thousands
entry.summary: For years, customers have complained of aggressive sales tactics and charges at mall skincare stores. NPR investigated the business that connects many of them.

entry.title: In Kansas, a newly competitive Senate race tests limit of Trump's unpopular policies
entry.summary: Kansas voters could send a Democrat to the Senate for the first time in nearly a century — and flip the governor's office back to Republican control, even in what could be a tough year for the GOP.

entry.title: Civil rights advocates plan to send thousands of observers to midterm polling places
entry.summary: For many election cycles, civil rights groups and political parties have fanned out to monitor polling places, but the charged midterm environment has many organizations stepping up efforts this year.
